facts.fact: The ranking measures Canadian companies on three-year revenue growth, and StackAdapt reported three-year growth of 754%.
facts.quote: Canada’s Top Growing Companies ranks Canadian companies on three-year revenue growth. StackAdapt earned its spot with three-year growth of 754%.

facts.fact: A total of 400 companies earned a spot on the 2020 Canada's Top Growing Companies ranking.
facts.quote: In total, 400 companies earned a spot on this year’s ranking.

facts.fact: The Canada's Top Growing Companies ranking was launched in 2019 and is a voluntary program requiring an in-depth application process to qualify.
facts.quote: Launched in 2019, the Canada’s Top Growing Companies editorial ranking aims to celebrate entrepreneurial achievement in Canada
